_doc: Authored expectation (real tree-sitter-c-sharp only; skipped while the grammar is not installed, UNVERIFIED until it runs; the expectation was derived against the engine with the scripted backend). Closed world. `alive` = never reported dead (alive, or weak-alive: a path that has an N edge such as the call `new Service(...).Run()`, a member of an unnamed receiver, or the interface call `_repo.Save()`). Program is alive through Main (the holder edge). Service.Run is reached by the chained call; Dto only as the type argument of Deserialize and Dto.Name only by the serializer (a public instance property is a data member, rules.json protocol); the static field Counter is not. MemRepo.Save is a name match of `_repo.Save()` (there is no static typing without SCIP), so MemRepo is weak-alive, not test-only; the test class and its test method are test-only (test_only: a subset check).
